notes: Recorded 164 master's programme rows: every approved field of study listed on the ADB institutions page for all 8 places (Hong Kong, India, Japan, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, USA) and all designated institutions. This is the full official list as the page prints it.

The page does not state a total number of programmes. Its introduction says the programme enrolls about 250 students a year in 9 countries, while the programme page and the earlier summary say about 135 scholarships a year; the figures disagree on the ADB site.

Where the page lists a degree followed by fields (International Rice Research Institute: Master of Agriculture in Agronomy plus 25 Master of Science fields; Asian Institute of Technology: Master of Sciences or Engineering in each field) each field is one row with the degree stated in the detail text.

Institute of Science Tokyo: the page warns that some departments might not call for master's students. Intake months and deadlines are as printed on the page; the page says they apply all year round, so check the intake year with each university.
